workload.note: one GLM-4.7-Flash MoE decoder layer (layer kind covering 46/47 layers), deployment dtypes: bf4 attention + bf4 shared expert + bf4 routed experts, bf8 dense MLP + prefill flat copies, bf8 latent cache, LoFi decode

named_limitations: per-op traced-replay dispatch cost (~2.3 us/op over ~68 ops) dominates the e2e-vs-device gap; every further packing/fusion candidate was measured or has a recorded blocker (the +6.7 ops vs fused are measured winning-candidate glue)
M=1-tile decode matmuls are launch/latency-bound on Blackhole: dominant DRAM-sharded rows run at 33-61% DRAM utilization despite swept in0_block_w/geometry
sparse_matmul pays an op-internal full-output zero-fill (~18 us/step, FillPadDeviceOperation), known since the fused stage
sparse_matmul out_subblock_w>1 corrupts multi-group outputs in non-indexed mode (repro in work_log.md), blocking a faster union/prefill subblock shape
ttnn.topk k=4 runs internally as k=32 plus slices; routing-weight pick chain has a ~15 us single-core latency floor (gather was 37 us; replaced by an 18 us embedding-table chain)
